**Assignment and Role:** As an actuarial assistant, I will evaluate the data preparation phase of a frequency prediction model for insurance claims to ensure it is accurate, reliable, and well-structured for downstream modeling tasks.

**Critical Evaluation Steps:**

• **Data Quality Check**: Verify data completeness, consistency, and accuracy of key variables (e.g., policy details, claim data).
• **Handling Missing Values**: Assess strategies for imputing missing values, such as mean/median/mode imputation or more sophisticated methods.
• **Data Normalization/Scaling**: Evaluate the need for scaling/normalization of numeric variables to prevent feature dominance.
• **Outlier Detection**: Identify and address outliers in the data, which may skew model predictions.
• **Feature Engineering**: Review the selection and creation of relevant features for the frequency prediction model.
• **Data Partitioning**: Verify the appropriateness of the data split for training, validation, and testing sets.
